excerpt.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！尽管我们发出了警告，你们仍未对[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]进行的不当实验采取任何行动。看来你们并不在意自己的未来啊。
excerpt.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Despite our warnings, you have elected to do nothing about the heretical research being carried out in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears your species may not be worth saving after all.
